title: stk doctor --probe --json
description: What `stk doctor --probe --json` prints on stdout: one row per client probed through a real broker, in order. stk exits 1 on a bypass or a failed client and still prints this; the human report goes to stderr. Written from supertoolkit internal/doctor/probe.go (`row`). AgentPod's node-agent requires `client` and `outcome` on every row and refuses a non-zero exit when every row is `honoured` (stkclient.go, Probe). On failure stk exits non-zero and writes `stk: <message>` to stderr; that text and the exit code are not part of this contract (phase 4, ruling 4).
